title: Spot the BlindSpots: Systematic Identification and Quantification of Fine-Grained LLM Biases in Contact Center Summaries
reasoning: The paper focuses on operational biases within business call summarization, such as sentiment, topic, and speaker prominence. It identifies and quantifies these as 'Operational Bias' for contact center use cases. While it contains a standard ethics statement regarding transparency and data usage, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
